findings.title: mark_failed_threshold and helpers removed/renamed, breaking any existing importers
findings.body: This PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and the `SimpleCheckIn` TypedDict from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, moving/renaming them to new modules (`mark_failed_threshold` becomes `try_incident_threshold` in `incidents.py`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` becomes `create_incident_occurrence` in `incident_occurrence.py`). No backwards-compatible aliases are left behind. Any module, task, or test outside this diff that imports these names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (e.g., timeout/missed check-in tasks or existing tests calling `mark_failed_threshold` directly) will fail with ImportError after merge. The diff shows no corresponding updates to call sites or tests, so this should be verified and all importers updated (or re-export shims added) before merging.

findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context builds display-config but returns the raw config
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into `config` and replaces `schedule_type` with its human-readable display value, but then returns `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` — the original raw config — instead of the modified copy. The display conversion is therefore dead code and the `schedule_type` in the emitted monitor context is the raw integer rather than the display string. This appears to be a pre-existing bug carried over verbatim in the move, but the refactor is a good point to fix it by returning `"config": config`.
